_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/muntplein.json — RoomSpec for Muntplein (the city, district 2: the Munt): the square over the water where the Singel begins and Rokin runs north, the Munttoren on its corner with its clock stopped at 11:47, the trams' rails curving through it, crowd barriers across the way up Rokin. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).

interactables.text: The Munttoren. Its clock stopped at 11:47. Up in the lantern the carillon still plays a few bars every quarter hour, to nobody.
The Singel. Something under the water is moving the boats against the quay, slowly, like breathing.
Rokin. Crowd barriers across it, one pushed flat. Beyond them, the long road to Centraal.
